newsitem.title: UK: Melrose Energy's Sibir listing set for April.
newsitem.headline: Melrose Energy's Sibir listing set for April.

text.p: Sabir Energy Plc, a unit set up by Melrose Energy Plc last September to take part in a Siberian oil deal, is to seek a listing on London's Alternative Investment Market in April.

Sibir said in a statement it had applied for its entire share capital to be admitted to AIM on April 8. It announced an Underwritten Offer of up to 35 million new ordinary shares of 10 pence each to qualifying shareholders of Melrose at 10 pence per share.
Melrose set up Sibir in September to acquire an indirect 20 percent stake in Evikhon, which has interests in oil and gas fields in the Khanty-Maniysk region of Western Siberia.
The AIM admission document containing the offer is being sent out to qualifying shareholders in Melrose today along with application forms. The closing date for completed forms is April 2.
